source_page_html:
Harborline Exchange — Core and Shell Construction

Procurement type: Construction tender. Buyer: North Quay Commercial Properties Ltd. Project location: 410 Alder Quay, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

Overall scope

Construct a six-storey commercial office building, including foundations, structural frame, building envelope, base-building mechanical and electrical systems, and associated site connections.

Packages

  • Package 01 — Structural frame and core: foundations, concrete frame, stairs, and elevator cores. Estimated value: CAD 18,400,000.
  • Package 02 — Mechanical and electrical systems: base-building HVAC, electrical distribution, lighting, and plumbing. Estimated value: CAD 9,650,000.
  • Package 03 — Façade and glazing: curtain wall, exterior glazing, and weatherproofing. Estimated value: CAD 4,200,000.

Eligibility

  • Demonstrate completion of at least two comparable commercial buildings within the past eight years.
  • Maintain commercial general liability insurance with a minimum limit of CAD 5,000,000 per occurrence.
  • Submit a project-specific health and safety plan and identify the proposed site superintendent.

Key dates

Published: 2026-01-12. Optional site visit: 2026-02-03 at 10:00. Questions due: 2026-02-10 at 17:00. Bids due: 2026-02-24 at 14:00. All times are Pacific Standard Time (PST).

Submission

Submit electronically through the North Quay Bid Room. No public portal address is listed. No paper copies are required. Upload one searchable PDF bid package with separate pricing schedules.

  • Signed tender form and package pricing schedule
  • Company profile and comparable-project references
  • Insurance certificate
  • Project-specific health and safety plan
  • Preliminary construction schedule

Contact

Mara Ellison, Procurement Manager, North Quay Commercial Properties Ltd.
